metadata.title: Vintage Nautical Playing Card Tuck Box

retrievalProfile.description: A structured, multi-paneled vintage packaging layout featuring nautical wave motifs, sunbursts, and heavy ornamental typography within a geometric border.
triggerTerms: navy and gold wave pattern label

recipe.visualDefinition: A flat-lay graphic of a playing card box front, characterized by a navy blue, white, and gold color palette. The design is divided into horizontal tiers: a top section with a wave-and-sunburst arc, a central bold typographic nameplate, and a bottom section with diagonal text and a large numerical identifier, all enclosed in a border of dots and card suit icons.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical central alignment of the main title and top arc
Diagonal tension in the bottom panel contrasting with horizontal tiers
Repetitive geometric dot borders framing the entire composition
High-contrast layering of white and gold text against navy backgrounds
coreInvariants: Stylized cresting wave pattern in the top arc
Four card suit icons (heart, spade, club, diamond) in the corners

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main title occupies the central horizontal third of the frame, acting as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central nameplate with gold-outlined white lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central title, moves up to the wave arc, then follows the diagonal text in the bottom left toward the large number in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White space is used as a thick outer border and to separate internal geometric panels.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold/Yellow (Sunburst, title outlines, and decorative accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between dark navy and bright white/gold for legibility.

letterConstructionRules: Main title features flared serifs and horizontal decorative bars through the center of the glyphs
Secondary text is highly condensed with vertical emphasis
Numerical elements are oversized with thick, slab-like strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title have a 'belted' appearance with a horizontal line crossing the midsection
The 'O' in the number section is elevated with a dot underneath
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of wide, ornate display type with ultra-condensed geometric sans-serifs.

preserve: The 'belted' look of the main title
The diagonal orientation of the lower-left text
The wave motif in the top arc

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the ornate, historical feel of the main title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a navy blue rectangular frame with a white outer border. Inside, create three horizontal sections. The top section contains a white and navy wave arc over a gold sunburst. The middle section is a navy rectangle with a gold border. The bottom section is split diagonally from bottom-left to top-right. Add small card suit icons in the four corners and a dotted line border inside the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a bold, white, Victorian-style display font with gold outlines to the center box. Add ultra-condensed white sans-serif text following the diagonal line in the bottom-left section. Place a large white number '1' in the bottom-right section.

verificationChecks: Is the main title centered and 'belted'?
Are the four card suits present in the corners?
Is the wave pattern stylized and rhythmic?
Is the color palette strictly navy, white, and gold?

adjustableVariables: Number of waves in the top arc
Angle of the diagonal text in the bottom panel
mustRedesign: Any specific brand names or logos
The specific 'GH' monogram at the bottom center
postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of the dotted border
Ensure the wave arc is centered above the title
Check that the diagonal text is parallel to the divider line
Confirm the navy blue is deep and consistent
recipe.reuseFormula: Victorian Nautical Packaging = (Navy + Gold + White Palette) + (Symmetrical Tiered Layout) + (Wave/Sunburst Arc) + (Ornate Belted Display Type) + (Diagonal Condensed Subtitles)
